terms.gloss: untilled, uncultivated; hence unadorned, unpolished, neglected, rough
evidence: Liv. 2.34.2: cāritās annōnae ex incultīs agrīs (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: tēcta īnfōrmia imposita rūpibus, pecora jūmentaque torrida frīgore, hominēs intōnsī et incultī
phrases.english: shapeless huts perched on the crags, flocks and beasts of burden pinched with cold, men unshorn and unkempt
the high price of corn that came of the untilled fields
